name: BFCL - Overall
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.accuracy, 1) AS "Accuracy (%)", res.correct_count AS "✓ Correct", res.total_count AS "# Total" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'bfcl' ORDER BY "Accuracy (%)" DESC, "# Total" DESC

name: BFCL - By Category
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, kv.key AS "Category", ROUND((json_extract(kv.value, '$.success')::FLOAT / json_extract(kv.value, '$.total')::FLOAT * 100), 1) AS "Accuracy (%)", json_extract(kv.value, '$.success')::INTEGER AS "✓", json_extract(kv.value, '$.total')::INTEGER AS "Total" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM json_each(res.category_stats)) AS kv WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'bfcl' ORDER BY id, "Accuracy (%)" DESC

name: ComplexFuncBench - Overall
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.overall_success_rate, 1) AS "Success Rate (%)", ROUND(res.overall_call_accuracy, 1) AS "Call Acc (%)", res.successful_samples || '/' || res.total_samples AS "Tasks", ROUND(COALESCE(res.avg_completeness, 0), 2) AS "Completeness", ROUND(COALESCE(res.avg_correctness, 0), 2) AS "Correctness" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'cfb' OR res.config.benchmark = 'complexfuncbench' ORDER BY "Success Rate (%)" DESC, "Call Acc (%)" DESC

name: ComplexFuncBench - By Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, kv.key AS "Domain", ROUND((json_extract(kv.value, '$.success')::FLOAT / json_extract(kv.value, '$.total')::FLOAT * 100), 1) AS "Success Rate (%)", json_extract(kv.value, '$.success')::INTEGER || '/' || json_extract(kv.value, '$.total')::INTEGER AS "Tasks", ROUND((json_extract(kv.value, '$.correct_calls')::FLOAT / json_extract(kv.value, '$.total_calls')::FLOAT * 100), 1) AS "Call Acc (%)" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM json_each(res.domain_stats)) AS kv WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'cfb' OR res.config.benchmark = 'complexfuncbench' ORDER BY id, "Success Rate (%)" DESC

name: Tau2 - Single Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, res.domain AS "Domain", ROUND(res.pass_rate, 1) AS "Pass Rate (%)", CAST(res.score AS INTEGER) || '/' || res.max_score AS "Score", ROUND(res.time_used, 1) AS "Time (s)" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'tau2' AND res.domain != 'all' ORDER BY "Domain", "Pass Rate (%)" DESC, "Time (s)" ASC

name: Tau2 - Multi Domain
query: SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, ROUND(res.pass_rate, 1) AS "Overall Pass Rate (%)", CAST(res.score AS INTEGER) || '/' || res.max_score AS "Overall Score", ROUND(res.airline_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Airline (%)", ROUND(res.retail_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Retail (%)", ROUND(res.telecom_stats.pass_rate, 1) AS "Telecom (%)", ROUND(res.time_used, 1) AS "Time (s)" FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS results CROSS JOIN UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res) WHERE res.config.benchmark = 'tau2' AND res.domain = 'all' ORDER BY "Overall Pass Rate (%)" DESC, "Time (s)" ASC
